title: fix(plugin-charts,app-shell): rotated x-axis labels fit their band; the dashboard inspector stacks its Layout fields (objectui#11796)
body:
Fixes #11796

Clause-②: no

Two layout defects on the dashboard surface, each repaired where its owner lives. Fractional y ticks on count charts are tracked in objectui#11681, which stays open and is not part of this change.

## 1. Rotated x-axis labels: the band is sized from the labels

**Mechanism (measured, not inferred).** A rotated label is anchored at its END (`textAnchor: 'end'`) and turned 35° away from the plot, so its START hangs farthest from the plot. The axis reserved a fixed `height: 60`. That number counted the text width alone and left out recharts' `tickSize` offset and the rotated line box. The longest labels the 12-character cap lets through therefore ran past it. The clip is the chart SVG's own viewport (an inner SVG is `overflow: hidden` by default). No ancestor clipped in the measured shapes: the widget card is `overflow-hidden`, but it grows with its content.

**Change** (`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`):
- `rotatedXAxisHeight` derives the band from the longest label the axis draws: `tickSize + tickMargin + 1em·cos(35°) + width·sin(35°)`.
- The width is a deliberate upper estimate (`estimateLabelWidthPx`), because the tick text has no width before paint and recharts' measuring helper is not public API. A wide glyph (CJK, kana, Hangul, full-width forms) counts as 1em and every other glyph as 0.65em, about the all-capitals advance of the sans fonts the tick inherits.
- The 12-character ellipsis now applies to EVERY rotated label, not only the five-bucket branch, so the band stays bounded. Above the bound, a long label used to be clipped mid-word; it is now shortened the same way. The bar's tooltip still carries the full name.
- Axes whose labels do not rotate are untouched (recharts' default 30px band).

**Real-browser reading.** A temporary Vite harness, never committed, rendered the real `DashboardRenderer` in Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, 1440×900) at an 800px dashboard width. It ran in both runtime mode and the designer shape (`DashboardPreview`'s `max-h-[70vh] overflow-auto` and `min-w-[768px]` wrappers, `designMode` with reorder on). A fake `queryDataset` returned the showcase *Delivery Operations* widgets' categories. "Band" is the reserved height under the plot. "Deepest" is how far the lowest painted label reaches below the plot, from each label's rotated `getBoundingClientRect`.

| widget | before: band / deepest | after: band / deepest |
|---|---|---|
| Projects by Health (green / yellow / red) | 60 / 46 | 53 / 46 |
| Tasks by Status (Backlog … In Progress … Done) | 60 / 61 | 76 / 61 |
| 12-char ellipsised labels (Needs Analy… etc.) | 60 / 71 | 80 / 71 |
| same two charts with `chartConfig.showLegend: false` | 60 / 61 and 60 / 71: the SVG ends 65px under the plot, and **3 labels lose their starts** (Prospecting…, Needs Analy…, Negotiation…) | 76 / 61 and 80 / 71: **0 labels cross the SVG** |

The tick font is a system stack (`-apple-system … system-ui, sans-serif`), so painted widths depend on the machine. This sandbox resolves Inter. With the legend on, the overrun lands in the legend band, and I could not reproduce the card's exact "acklog" / "ogress" cut here. The card's machine and fonts are not available to me. What the harness does show is the mechanism: labels overrun the fixed 60px wherever their font is wider or nothing sits under the band. Measured 12px advances, Inter vs DejaVu Sans: "In Progress" 64.2 / 66.2px, "Needs Analy…" 81.4 / 87.0px. A CJK label is a full 12px per glyph.

## 2. Dashboard inspector: the Layout fields stack

**Where the three columns come from.** `@objectstack/spec`'s `dashboardForm` declares its Layout section with `columns: 3` (and the `header` composite with `colSpan: 3`). `SchemaForm` honours a section's `columns` regardless of its host's width. `DashboardDefaultInspector.tsx` is the only consumer of `getDashboardForm`, and it renders that form in a narrow side panel.

**Change** (`DashboardDefaultInspector.tsx` only): `stackSectionsForNarrowPanel` renders every section of the form as one column after the server-field graft, and clamps each field's `colSpan` to 1. A span of 3 in a one-column grid would add implicit tracks past the panel's edge. `SchemaForm.tsx`'s shared grid is not touched: every other form keeps the columns its sections declare.

**Real-browser reading** (same harness, the inspector in a fixed-width panel):

| panel | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 300px | three 67px columns; "Refresh Interval Seconds" wraps to 3 lines | one 232px column; every label on one line |
| 240px | three 47px columns; the screenshot shows "12" as "1" and "60" as "6", the card's symptom | one 172px column; values whole |

## Tests

New pins, read through rendered geometry. happy-dom paints no text, so the chart pins hold the band against label widths Chromium painted, recorded once as fixtures in the test header.
- `AdvancedChartImpl.rotatedLabelBand-11796.test.tsx`: the card's labels fit; the longest capped label fits; a CJK label is charged a full em; a longer label reserves more; above the five-bucket bound a 38-char name is ellipsised and reserves exactly what its 12-char form does; control: a non-rotating axis keeps 30px.
- `DashboardDefaultInspector.layoutColumns-11796.test.tsx`: Columns / Gap / Refresh Interval Seconds share one `repeat(1, minmax(0, 1fr))` grid; every cell of that section (the `header` composite included) is `span 1`; control: `SchemaForm` given the same spec form keeps `repeat(3, …)`.

Runs (all through `os-verify-lock`, verdict `command-exit 0`, final head `bf2a3ba`, which is a merge of `main` 59ce048 that touches none of these files):
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/` plus the 42-file app-shell set below: **132 files, 1523 passed, 9 skipped**.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` after building both packages' dependency closures: both exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists each new test file once.
- **Declared narrowing:** the full app-shell suite (1082 test files) is CI's. In the shared verify-lock's ledger, a full app-shell run held the lock 25 to 47 minutes, past this container's foreground cap. The local set is every app-shell test file that names `DashboardDefaultInspector`, `dashboard-schema`, `getDashboardForm`, `register-builtins` or `default-inspector-registry`, plus every `ResourceEditPage` / `StudioDesignSurface` / inspector test that mounts a `'dashboard'`. The positive control, `DashboardDefaultInspector.test.tsx`, is in it: 42 files, 304 tests on `9957feb`, re-run green inside the 132 above on `bf2a3ba`.

**Ablation** (on `9957feb`, through `ablation-replace.mjs`: each anchor hit once and landed; each restore proved `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
- band back to `height: 60`: 4 of 6 chart pins red (card labels, capped label, CJK, longer-reserves-more). The above-bound and control pins stay green, as they should, because that leg does not touch them.
- the stacking removed (`form: merged.form`): both inspector pins red, the `SchemaForm` control green.
- wide glyphs charged the narrow advance: only the CJK pin red.
- the ellipsis scoped back to the five-bucket branch: only the above-bound pin red.
- restored tree: 9/9 green.

**Lint:** `pnpm exec eslint --format json` on the 4 touched source and test files at `bf2a3ba`: 4 files, 0 errors. `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` keeps exactly the 44 warnings the base file has, and the new chart test has 2 (`any` in its `vi.mock` factory, as its sibling tests do). The population is each package's own `lint` script, `eslint .`. Invariance: `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService` or `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

**Gates at `bf2a3ba`**, each exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:spec-symbols`, and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`. No locale pack, export or README surface changed, so the i18n and readme-export gates do not apply.

Changeset: `.changeset/11796-rotated-labels-layout.md`, `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-charts` and `@object-ui/app-shell`. Nothing is added to either package entry: no export, prop, type member or language-pack key.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same family, not changed here:** other narrow inspectors also feed spec sections with `columns: 2` through the same grid: `actionForm` (Basics, Advanced), `pageForm` (Basics) and `viewForm` (Table options). I did not measure them in a panel. Closing the whole class would mean a container-aware `SchemaForm` grid, which is off this card's surface. That is a seat decision.
- The x-axis title (`xAxis.title`) is laid out `insideBottom` of the same band. It moves with the band and was not measured with rotated labels.
- The ellipsis counts UTF-16 code units (`label.length` / `slice`), so a cut through an astral character (an emoji) can split its surrogate pair. This predates the change and is now reached on more axes. Not measured.
- `hasLongLabels` rotates only when a label is longer than 5 code units, so a 3 to 5 glyph CJK label stays horizontal. This predates the change and was not measured.

Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`.
